newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE SELL STEADY $64,LIGHT-USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE SELL STEADY $64,LIGHT-USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers steady.

Feedlots reporting fairly good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 200 slaughter steers and 200 heifers; 40,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 31,700 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Wk to date - 40,900 Last Week - 32,600 Year Ago - 27,200
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1100 lbs 64.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
